methods.name: speech.dictation.start
methods.resultShape: {dictationId, modelId} on success, where modelId is the resolved model (params.modelId || voice.sttModel).
methods.absentNullUndefinedCoercion: params.modelId falsy (undefined or '') falls back to voice.sttModel via `||` (empty string is treated the same as undefined, not preserved as an explicit empty selection); if that is also falsy, throws rather than silently defaulting to any specific model.
methods.stateChanges: Sets the single module-level `session` field to a new MobileDictationSession (state:'starting') before awaiting startDictation, transitions it to 'active' on success, or clears it back to null if this call's session is still the current one at failure time.
methods.errorsThrownVsReturned: Thrown only, checked in this order: Error('voice_dictation_disabled') if !voice.enabled; Error('voice_model_not_selected') if no modelId resolves; Error(`voice_model_not_ready:${modelState.status}`) if getModelState(modelId).status !== 'ready' (interpolates live model state into the message string itself, not a separate field); Error('dictation_requires_mobile_client') if !params.clientId; Error('dictation_already_active') if a session already exists (hard single-session invariant, not a queue); Error('dictation_canceled') if a concurrent call replaced this.session mid-await; any startDictation() rejection re-thrown verbatim.
methods.partialSuccess: A concurrent start() racing another start()/cancel() can observe its own just-created session silently replaced mid-flight and throw 'dictation_canceled' even though the underlying startDictation() call itself succeeded -- an explicit non-silent race guard, not a defect per se, but a partial-success shape worth a dedicated test.

methods.name: speech.dictation.cancel
methods.resultShape: {dictationId} literal, always returned regardless of whether an actual session was canceled.
methods.absentNullUndefinedCoercion: If session is absent, or dictationId/clientId/connectionId don't match ownership, cancel() is a complete no-op that still returns {dictationId} as if it had canceled something -- absent-session and successful-cancel are indistinguishable from the return value alone.
methods.stateChanges: On a matched session: sets state to 'closing', awaits stopDictation, then clears this.session in a finally block only if it still matches the session captured at call start (a session replaced mid-cancel by a fresh concurrent start() is NOT cleared by this stale cancel call, avoiding cross-session clobber).
